rows.Name: _Project Schedule Risk Score
rows.Expression:
VAR DueSoonDays = 30
VAR LowProgress = 0.8
VAR Overdue =
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            'Projects',
            NOT ISBLANK('Projects'[Finish Date])
                && 'Projects'[Finish Date] < TODAY()
                && COALESCE('Projects'[Progress], 0) < 1
        )
    )
VAR DueSoonLowProgress =
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            'Projects',
            NOT ISBLANK('Projects'[Finish Date])
                && 'Projects'[Finish Date] >= TODAY()
                && 'Projects'[Finish Date] <= TODAY() + DueSoonDays
                && COALESCE('Projects'[Progress], 0) < LowProgress
        )
    )
RETURN
    MIN(100, Overdue * 40 + DueSoonLowProgress * 25)

rows.Name: _Project Cost Risk Score
rows.Expression:
VAR ForecastVarianceThreshold = 0.15
VAR OverBudgetProjects =
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            'Projects',
            'Projects'[Budget Cost] > 0
                && DIVIDE('Projects'[Forecast Cost] - 'Projects'[Budget Cost], 'Projects'[Budget Cost], 0) > ForecastVarianceThreshold
        )
    )
VAR BudgetVariance =
    MAX(0, [_Forecast Budget Overrun %])
RETURN
    MIN(100, OverBudgetProjects * 25 + BudgetVariance * 100)

VAR CurrentStatusProjects =

                && 'Projects'[gbl_laststatusupdate] >= TODAY() - StaleStatusDays

RETURN

rows.Name: _Project Attention Reason
rows.Expression:
VAR StaleStatusDays = 14
VAR DueSoonDays = 30
VAR LowProgress = 0.8
VAR ForecastVarianceThreshold = 0.15
VAR HasStaleStatus =
    MAXX(
        'Projects',
        IF(
            ISBLANK('Projects'[gbl_laststatusupdate])
                || 'Projects'[gbl_laststatusupdate] < TODAY() - StaleStatusDays,
            1,
            0
        )
    ) = 1
VAR IsOverdue =
    MAXX(
        'Projects',
        IF(
            NOT ISBLANK('Projects'[Finish Date])
                && 'Projects'[Finish Date] < TODAY()
                && COALESCE('Projects'[Progress], 0) < 1,
            1,
            0
        )
    ) = 1
VAR IsDueSoonLowProgress =
    MAXX(
        'Projects',
        IF(
            NOT ISBLANK('Projects'[Finish Date])
                && 'Projects'[Finish Date] >= TODAY()
                && 'Projects'[Finish Date] <= TODAY() + DueSoonDays
                && COALESCE('Projects'[Progress], 0) < LowProgress,
            1,
            0
        )
    ) = 1
VAR HasBudgetRisk =
    MAXX(
        'Projects',
        IF(
            'Projects'[Budget Cost] > 0
                && DIVIDE('Projects'[Forecast Cost] - 'Projects'[Budget Cost], 'Projects'[Budget Cost], 0) > ForecastVarianceThreshold,
            1,
            0
        )
    ) = 1
VAR Reasons =
    {
        IF(HasStaleStatus, "Stale status", BLANK()),
        IF(IsOverdue, "Overdue", BLANK()),
        IF(IsDueSoonLowProgress, "Due soon and low progress", BLANK()),
        IF(HasBudgetRisk, "Forecast over budget", BLANK())
    }
VAR Result =
    CONCATENATEX(
        FILTER(Reasons, NOT ISBLANK([Value])),
        [Value],
        "; "
    )
RETURN
    IF(Result = BLANK(), "No attention reason", Result)

rows.Name: _Resource Overload Score
rows.Expression:
VAR CriticalThreshold = 1.2
VAR OverThreshold = 1.0
VAR Utilization = [% Utilization]
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(Utilization), BLANK(),
        Utilization >= CriticalThreshold, 100,
        Utilization > OverThreshold, 70,
        Utilization >= 0.9, 30,
        0
    )

rows.Name: _Resource Availability Score
rows.Expression:
VAR GapPercent = [_Resource Capacity Gap %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(GapPercent), BLANK(),
        GapPercent < 0, 0,
        GapPercent < 0.1, 40,
        GapPercent < 0.3, 70,
        100
    )

rows.Name: _Resource Forecast Quality Score
rows.Expression:
VAR WarningThreshold = 0.2
VAR Demand = [_Resource Demand Hours]
VAR Actuals = [_TS-Hours]
VAR VariancePercent = ABS(DIVIDE(Actuals - Demand, Demand, 0))
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Demand = 0 && Actuals = 0, BLANK(),
        VariancePercent <= WarningThreshold, 100,
        VariancePercent <= WarningThreshold * 2, 70,
        VariancePercent <= WarningThreshold * 3, 40,
        0
    )

rows.Name: _Resource Bottleneck Score
rows.Expression:
VAR OverloadScore = [_Resource Overload Score]
VAR AvailabilityRisk = 100 - [_Resource Availability Score]
VAR ForecastRisk = 100 - [_Resource Forecast Quality Score]
RETURN
    ROUND(
        MIN(
            100,
            COALESCE(OverloadScore, 0) * 0.5
                + COALESCE(AvailabilityRisk, 0) * 0.3
                + COALESCE(ForecastRisk, 0) * 0.2
        ),
        0
    )

rows.Name: _Department Capacity Risk Score
rows.Expression:
VAR GapPercent = [_Resource Capacity Gap %]
VAR Overallocated = [_Resources Overallocated]
VAR WithDemandNoCapacity = [_Resources With Demand No Capacity]
RETURN
    ROUND(
        MIN(
            100,
            IF(GapPercent < 0, ABS(GapPercent) * 100, 0)
                + Overallocated * 10
                + WithDemandNoCapacity * 20
        ),
        0
    )

rows.Name: _Resource Attention Reason
rows.Expression:
VAR CriticalThreshold = 1.2
VAR OverThreshold = 1.0
VAR TimesheetLowThreshold = 0.7
VAR Utilization = [% Utilization]
VAR HasCriticalOverload = Utilization >= CriticalThreshold
VAR HasOverload = Utilization > OverThreshold && NOT HasCriticalOverload
VAR HasDemandNoCapacity = [_Resources With Demand No Capacity] > 0
VAR HasLowTimesheetCoverage = [_Timesheet Coverage %] > 0 && [_Timesheet Coverage %] < TimesheetLowThreshold
VAR HasMissingMasterData = [_Resources With Missing Master Data] > 0
VAR Reasons =
    {
        IF(HasCriticalOverload, "Critical overallocation", BLANK()),
        IF(HasOverload, "Overallocation", BLANK()),
        IF(HasDemandNoCapacity, "Demand without capacity", BLANK()),
        IF(HasLowTimesheetCoverage, "Low timesheet coverage", BLANK()),
        IF(HasMissingMasterData, "Missing master data", BLANK())
    }
VAR Result =
    CONCATENATEX(
        FILTER(Reasons, NOT ISBLANK([Value])),
        [Value],
        "; "
    )
RETURN
    IF(Result = BLANK(), "No attention reason", Result)

VAR KeysPerGrain =
    DISTINCT(
        SELECTCOLUMNS(
            'Ressouce Demand with Working Hours',
            "ResourceID", 'Ressouce Demand with Working Hours'[ResourceID],
            "DepartmentID", 'Ressouce Demand with Working Hours'[DepartmentID],
            "CapDate", 'Ressouce Demand with Working Hours'[Capacity Date],
            "CapDays", 'Ressouce Demand with Working Hours'[Capacity]

RETURN
SUMX(KeysPerGrain, [CapDays] * 8.0)

rows.Name: Aktuelle Phase (Zeitstrahl)
rows.Expression:
VAR _ReportDate =
    COALESCE(
        MAX('Status Reports'[Report Date]),
        TODAY()
    )
VAR _ProjectIds = VALUES(Projects[ProjectID])
VAR _UseProjectFilter =
    ISCROSSFILTERED(Projects[ProjectID])
        || ISCROSSFILTERED(Projects[gbl_projectnumber])
        || ISCROSSFILTERED(Projects[Project Name])
VAR CandidateRows =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        FILTER(
            'VollständigePhasenListe',
            NOT ISBLANK('VollständigePhasenListe'[Phasenmodell])
                && NOT ISBLANK('VollständigePhasenListe'[Aktuelle_Phase])
                && NOT ISBLANK('VollständigePhasenListe'[ModifiedOn])
                && 'VollständigePhasenListe'[CreatedOn] <= _ReportDate
                && 'VollständigePhasenListe'[ModifiedOn] <= _ReportDate
                && (
                    NOT _UseProjectFilter
                    || CONTAINS(_ProjectIds, Projects[ProjectID], 'VollständigePhasenListe'[Project_ID])
                )
        ),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Status Reports')
    )
VAR Latest =
    TOPN(
        1,
        CandidateRows,
        [ModifiedOn], DESC,
        [CreatedOn], DESC,
        [Project_ID], ASC,
        [ModelPhaseKey], ASC
    )
RETURN
IF(
    ISEMPTY(CandidateRows),
    BLANK(),
    MAXX(Latest, [Aktuelle_Phase])
)

rows.Name: Project Time (01)
rows.Expression:
VAR ProjectTimeWorkdays =
    SUMX (
        Projects,
        VAR s = Projects[Start Date]
        VAR e = Projects[Finish Date]
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK(s) && NOT ISBLANK(e) && s <= e,
                COUNTROWS (
                    FILTER (
                        ADDCOLUMNS ( CALENDAR ( s, e ), "Weekday", WEEKDAY ( [Date], 2 ) ),
                        [Weekday] <= 5
                    )
                ),
                0
            )
    )
VAR DaysElapsedWorkdays =
    SUMX (
        Projects,
        VAR s = Projects[Start Date]
        VAR e = Projects[Finish Date]
        VAR until = MIN ( TODAY(), e )
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK(s) && NOT ISBLANK(e) && s <= until,
                COUNTROWS (
                    FILTER (
                        ADDCOLUMNS ( CALENDAR ( s, until ), "Weekday", WEEKDAY ( [Date], 2 ) ),
                        [Weekday] <= 5
                    )
                ),
                0
            )
    )
VAR raw = DIVIDE(DaysElapsedWorkdays, ProjectTimeWorkdays)
RETURN MAX(0, MIN(1, raw))

rows.Name: Project Health Score

VAR ActionPenalty = MIN(20, [Overdue Actions] * 5)
VAR IssuePenalty = MIN(20, [Overdue Issues] * 5)
VAR StatusPenalty = IF([Status Report Is Overdue] = 1, 15, 0)
VAR BudgetPenalty = MIN(15, ABS([Budget Variance %]) * 100)
RETURN
MAX(0, ROUND(100 - RiskPenalty - ActionPenalty - IssuePenalty - StatusPenalty - BudgetPenalty, 0))

rows.Name: Latest Status Has Next Steps
rows.Expression:
VAR LatestRows = TOPN(1, 'Status Reports', 'Status Reports'[Report Date], DESC, 'Status Reports'[Modified Date], DESC)
RETURN
IF(LEN(TRIM(COALESCE(MAXX(LatestRows, 'Status Reports'[Planned Activities]), ""))) > 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Latest Status Has Missed Activities
rows.Expression:
VAR LatestRows = TOPN(1, 'Status Reports', 'Status Reports'[Report Date], DESC, 'Status Reports'[Modified Date], DESC)
RETURN
IF(LEN(TRIM(COALESCE(MAXX(LatestRows, 'Status Reports'[Missed Activities]), ""))) > 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Latest Status Has Sponsor Actions
rows.Expression:
VAR LatestRows = TOPN(1, 'Status Reports', 'Status Reports'[Report Date], DESC, 'Status Reports'[Modified Date], DESC)
RETURN
IF(LEN(TRIM(COALESCE(MAXX(LatestRows, 'Status Reports'[Sponsor Actions]), ""))) > 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Latest Status Completeness %
rows.Expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Latest Status Has Summary]
        + [Latest Status Has Accomplished]
        + [Latest Status Has Next Steps]
        + [Latest Status Has Missed Activities]
        + [Latest Status Has Sponsor Actions],
    5,
    0
)

rows.Name: Status Quality Score
rows.Expression: ROUND([Latest Status Completeness %] * 100, 0)

rows.Name: Project Control Score
rows.Expression:
VAR HealthPart = COALESCE([Project Health Score], 0) * 0.45
VAR StatusPart = COALESCE([Status Quality Score], 0) * 0.25
VAR MilestonePart = COALESCE([Milestone Delivery Confidence %], 0) * 100 * 0.20
VAR ActionPenalty = MIN(10, [Open Critical Actions] * 2)
RETURN
MAX(0, ROUND(HealthPart + StatusPart + MilestonePart - ActionPenalty, 0))

rows.Name: Project Control Color
rows.Expression:
VAR Score = [Project Control Score]
RETURN
SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Score), "#BDBDBD", Score >= 80, "#2ECC71", Score >= 60, "#F2C94C", "#EB5757")

rows.Name: Project Requires PM Attention
rows.Expression:
IF(
    [Project Control Score] < 60
        || [Open Critical Actions] > 0
        || [Critical Issue Count] > 0
        || [Overdue Milestones] > 0,
    1,
    0
)

rows.Name: Governance Owner Complete
rows.Expression: IF([Projects Missing Owner] = 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Governance Dates Complete
rows.Expression:
VAR MissingDates =
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
            CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(FILTER('Projects', ISBLANK('Projects'[Start Date]) || ISBLANK('Projects'[Finish Date])))) > 0
        )
    )
RETURN IF(COALESCE(MissingDates, 0) = 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Governance Baseline Complete
rows.Expression: IF([Projects Without Baseline] = 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Projects Missing Budget
Governance Budget Complete
rows.Expression: IF([Projects Missing Budget] = 0, 1, 0)

rows.Name: Projects Without Phase
Governance Compliance %
rows.Expression:
VAR TotalProjects = COUNTROWS(VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]))
VAR MaxIssues = TotalProjects * 5
VAR Issues =
    [Projects Missing Owner]
        + [Projects Missing Finish Date]
        + [Projects Without Baseline]
        + [Projects Missing Budget]
        + [Projects Without Phase]
RETURN
IF(TotalProjects = 0, BLANK(), MAX(0, 1 - DIVIDE(Issues, MaxIssues, 0)))

rows.Name: Projects Reported On Time
Projects Missing Current Report
rows.Expression: [Projects Without Recent Status]

rows.Name: Projects With Incomplete Report
Reporting Completeness %
rows.Expression:
VAR TotalProjects = COUNTROWS(VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]))
RETURN
IF(
    TotalProjects = 0,
    BLANK(),
    1 - DIVIDE([Projects Missing Current Report] + [Projects With Incomplete Report], TotalProjects * 2, 0)
)

rows.Name: Missing Owner Count
rows.Expression: [Projects Missing Owner]

rows.Name: Missing Baseline Count
rows.Expression: [Projects Without Baseline]

rows.Name: Missing Budget Count
rows.Expression: [Projects Missing Budget]

rows.Name: Missing Phase Count
rows.Expression: [Projects Without Phase]

rows.Name: Model Data Quality Score
rows.Expression: DIVIDE([PMO Data Quality Score] + [Governance Compliance %] + [Reporting Completeness %], 3, 0)

rows.Name: Projects Without Phase Model
Projects With Invalid Phase
Lifecycle Coverage %
rows.Expression:
VAR TotalProjects = COUNTROWS(VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]))
RETURN
IF(TotalProjects = 0, BLANK(), 1 - DIVIDE([Projects Without Phase Model] + [Projects With Invalid Phase], TotalProjects, 0))

rows.Name: Project Has PMO Exception
rows.Expression:
IF(
    [Status Report Is Overdue] = 1
        || [Projects Without Baseline] > 0
        || [Projects Missing Owner] > 0
        || [Projects Missing Budget] > 0
        || [Overdue Actions] > 0
        || [Overdue Issues] > 0
        || [Projects Without Phase Model] > 0,
    1,
    0
)

rows.Name: PMO Exception Count
PMO Critical Exception Count
rows.Expression:
COALESCE(
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
            CALCULATE([Project Health Score]) < 50
                || CALCULATE([High Risks]) > 0
                || CALCULATE([Overdue Issues]) > 0
                || CALCULATE([Status Report Is Overdue]) = 1
        )
    ),
    0
)

rows.Name: PMO Exception Severity Score
rows.Expression:
MIN(
    100,
    [PMO Critical Exception Count] * 10
        + ([PMO Exception Count] - [PMO Critical Exception Count]) * 2
)

rows.Name: Projects Needing Decision
Projects For Steering
Projects For Escalation
PMO Review Priority Score
rows.Expression:
MIN(
    100,
    [PMO Exception Severity Score]
        + [Overdue Actions] * 2
        + [Overdue Issues] * 4
        + [High Risks] * 5
        + [Overdue Decisions] * 5
)

rows.Name: Department Project Count
rows.Expression: DISTINCTCOUNT('Projects'[ProjectID])

rows.Name: Department Projects At Risk
rows.Expression: [Projects At Risk]

rows.Name: Department Critical Projects
rows.Expression: [Projects Critical]

rows.Name: Department Delivery Health %
rows.Expression: DIVIDE([Department Health Score], 100, 0)

rows.Name: Department Demand Hours
rows.Expression: [Capacity Demand Hours]

rows.Name: Department Available Hours
rows.Expression: [Available Capacity Hours]

rows.Name: Department Capacity Gap
rows.Expression: [Capacity Gap Hours]

rows.Name: Department Utilization %
rows.Expression: [Capacity Utilization %]

rows.Name: Department Budget
rows.Expression: SUM('Projects'[Budget Cost])

rows.Name: Department Forecast
rows.Expression: SUM('Projects'[Forecast Cost])

rows.Name: Department Overrun
rows.Expression: [Department Forecast] - [Department Budget]

rows.Name: Department Budget At Risk
rows.Expression: [Budget At Risk]

rows.Name: Projects Blocked By Capacity
Resource Bottleneck Count
rows.Expression: [Projects Blocked By Capacity]

rows.Name: Capacity Risk Score
rows.Expression: MIN(100, DIVIDE(MAX(0, [Capacity Gap Hours]), [Capacity Demand Hours], 0) * 100)

rows.Name: Department High Risks
rows.Expression: [High Risks]

rows.Name: Department Risk Exposure
rows.Expression: [Risk Exposure Value]

rows.Name: Department Escalation Count
rows.Expression: [Escalation Count]

rows.Name: Department Delivery Health Score
rows.Expression: [Department Health Score]

rows.Name: Executive Attention Projects
rows.Expression: [Projects Requiring Executive Attention]

rows.Name: Executive Attention Budget
rows.Expression:
SUMX(
    FILTER(
        VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
        CALCULATE([Executive Attention Flag]) = 1
    ),
    CALCULATE(SUM('Projects'[Forecast Cost]))
)

rows.Name: Executive Attention Risk Exposure
rows.Expression:
SUMX(
    FILTER(
        VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
        CALCULATE([Executive Attention Flag]) = 1
    ),
    CALCULATE([Risk Exposure Value])
)

rows.Name: Executive Attention Score
rows.Expression:
MIN(
    100,
    [Executive Attention Projects] * 5
        + [High Risks] * 4
        + [Overdue Decisions] * 5
        + MAX(0, [Portfolio Budget Variance %]) * 100
)

rows.Name: Portfolio Schedule Confidence %
rows.Expression: 1 - DIVIDE([Projects Behind Schedule], DISTINCTCOUNT('Projects'[ProjectID]), 0)

rows.Name: Portfolio Budget Confidence %
rows.Expression: 1 - MIN(1, MAX(0, [Portfolio Budget Variance %]))

rows.Name: Portfolio Risk Confidence %
rows.Expression: 1 - DIVIDE([Projects At Risk], DISTINCTCOUNT('Projects'[ProjectID]), 0)

rows.Name: Portfolio Delivery Confidence %
rows.Expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Delivery Confidence %]
        + [Portfolio Schedule Confidence %]
        + [Portfolio Budget Confidence %]
        + [Portfolio Risk Confidence %],
    4,
    0
)

rows.Name: Budget Value At Risk
rows.Expression: [Portfolio Value At Risk]

rows.Name: Benefit Value At Risk
rows.Expression:
SUMX(
    FILTER(
        VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
        CALCULATE([Executive Attention Flag]) = 1
    ),
    CALCULATE([Benefit Target Clean] - [Benefit Realized])
)

rows.Name: Strategic Value At Risk
rows.Expression:
SUMX(
    FILTER(
        VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
        CALCULATE([Is Strategic Project]) = 1
            && CALCULATE([Project Health Score]) < 60
    ),
    CALCULATE(SUM('Projects'[Forecast Cost]))
)

rows.Name: Is Strategic Project
rows.Expression:
IF(
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            'Projects',
            CONTAINSSTRING(LOWER(COALESCE('Projects'[Program Name], "")), "strateg")
                || CONTAINSSTRING(LOWER(COALESCE('Projects'[Tagging], "")), "strateg")
                || CONTAINSSTRING(LOWER(COALESCE('Projects'[gbl_tagging], "")), "strateg")
                || CONTAINSSTRING(LOWER(COALESCE('Projects'[Project Type], "")), "strateg")
                || CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Objectives')) > 0
        )
    ) > 0,
    1,
    0
)

rows.Name: Strategic Projects %
rows.Expression: DIVIDE([Strategic Projects Count], DISTINCTCOUNT('Projects'[ProjectID]), 0)

rows.Name: Strategic Projects At Risk %
rows.Expression: DIVIDE([Strategic Projects At Risk], [Strategic Projects Count], 0)

rows.Name: Projects Without Strategic Link
Strategic Alignment Score
rows.Expression: MAX(0, 100 - DIVIDE([Projects Without Strategic Link], DISTINCTCOUNT('Projects'[ProjectID]), 0) * 100)

rows.Name: Open Decisions
rows.Expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS('Decisions'),
    FILTER(
        'Decisions',
        NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[Status], "")) IN { "closed", "done", "completed", "approved", "inactive" })
            && NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[State], "")) IN { "inactive" })
    )
)

rows.Name: Overdue Decisions
rows.Expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS('Decisions'),
    FILTER(
        'Decisions',
        NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[Status], "")) IN { "closed", "done", "completed", "approved", "inactive" })
            && NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[State], "")) IN { "inactive" })
            && NOT(ISBLANK('Decisions'[Target Date]))
            && 'Decisions'[Target Date] < TODAY()
    )
)

rows.Name: Critical Decisions
rows.Expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS('Decisions'),
    FILTER(
        'Decisions',
        NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[Status], "")) IN { "closed", "done", "completed", "approved", "inactive" })
            && NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[State], "")) IN { "inactive" })
            && (
                'Decisions'[ExecutiveReportingID] = TRUE()
                || 'Decisions'[Health Number] >= 2
                || 'Decisions'[PriorityID] >= 2
            )
    )
)

rows.Name: Decision Aging Days
rows.Expression:
AVERAGEX(
    FILTER(
        'Decisions',
        NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[Status], "")) IN { "closed", "done", "completed", "approved", "inactive" })
            && NOT(LOWER(COALESCE('Decisions'[State], "")) IN { "inactive" })
    ),
    'Decisions'[Decision Age]
)

rows.Name: Decision Backlog Severity
rows.Expression: MIN(100, [Open Decisions] * 2 + [Overdue Decisions] * 8 + [Critical Decisions] * 10)

rows.Name: Benefit Target Clean
rows.Expression: [Benefit Target]

rows.Name: Benefit Gap
rows.Expression: [Benefit Target Clean] - [Benefit Realized]

rows.Name: Benefits At Risk
rows.Expression:
SUMX(
    FILTER(
        VALUES('Projects'[ProjectID]),
        CALCULATE([Project Health Score]) < 60
    ),
    CALCULATE([Benefit Gap])
)
